# AI Agent Instructions for Cucumber-Selenium-TestNG Framework

## Architecture Overview

**Cucumber BDD + Selenium WebDriver + TestNG** test automation framework with Page Object Model (POM), Picocontainer dependency injection, and parallel execution. Environment-driven configuration with centralized locator/property management.

# Code Annotation

- Always insert the comment '--Generated by Copilot' at the top of any new file or function generated.

### Core Components & Data Flow

**DriverManager** (`driverFactory/DriverManager.java`)
- ThreadLocal WebDriver management (Chrome/Firefox/Edge/Safari)
- **All browsers run headless by default** (`--headless`, `--no-sandbox`, `--disable-dev-shm-usage`)
- Uses WebDriverManager for automatic driver binary management (except Linux Chrome uses local binary)
- System property defaults: `-Dbrowser=edge`, `-Denv=QA`
- Implicit wait: 10 seconds, window maximized on startup

**TestContext** (`cucumber/TestContext.java`)
- Central DI container injected via constructor in step definitions (Picocontainer auto-wires)
- Manages driver lifecycle: `initializeDriver(browser)` → `getDriver()` → `closeDriver()`
- Creates PageObjectManager after driver initialization

**PageObjectManager** (`objectManager/PageObjectManager.java`)
- Lazy-initialized singleton page objects per test context
- Pattern: `return (page == null) ? page = new Page(driver) : page;`
- **Register ALL new pages here** or they won't be accessible to step definitions

**ApplicationHook** (`appHooks/ApplicationHook.java`)
- `@Before`: Empty (driver init deferred to first Given step in step defs)
- `@AfterStep`: Screenshot capture if `ATTACH_SCREENSHOT_TO_REPORT=Yes` (default: No for performance)
- `@After`: Screenshot on test failure + `driver.quit()` + scenario status logging
- `@AfterSuite` (TestRunner): Jira XRay REST API integration if `JiraUpdate=Yes`

**ElementUtil** (`utils/ElementUtil.java`)
- Selenium wrapper with **automatic retry logic**:
  - `doClick/doSendKeys`: Retries on StaleElementReferenceException/TimeoutException
  - Falls back to JavascriptExecutor if standard Selenium methods fail
  - All methods use explicit waits (WebDriverWait 10-15 seconds)
- **Always use ElementUtil methods** - never raw WebDriver calls in page objects

### Test Execution Flow

1. **TestNG trigger**: `testng.xml` → `TestRunner.java` (`@DataProvider(parallel=true)`)
2. **Parallel execution**: Thread count set in `pom.xml` → `<dataproviderthreadcount>1</dataproviderthreadcount>` (increase for faster runs)
3. **Feature file execution**: Cucumber glue paths: `stepDef/`, `appHooks/`
4. **Step definition**: Constructor-inject `TestContext`, call `testContext.initializeDriver(browser)` in first Given step
5. **Page interaction**: Get page from `testContext.getPageObjectManager().getXxxPage()`
6. **Teardown**: `@After` hook captures failure screenshots, quits driver
7. **Reporting**: Maven `post-integration-test` phase generates ExtentReports from `target/json-report/cucumber.json`

## Critical Patterns

### Environment-Based Configuration

**Property resolution hierarchy** (controlled by `-Denv` system property, defaults to "QA"):
```java
// PropertiesFileManager searches: environment/{QA|UAT}/environment.properties first, then all *.properties in folder
String url = PropertiesFileManager.getPropertyValue("MyURL"); // Resolves from environment/QA/environment.properties
String user = PropertiesFileManager.getPropertyValue("Username"); // Searches all QA/*.properties if not in environment.properties
```

**Key insight**: Properties can be split across multiple files (environment.properties, ApplicationUser.properties, Locator.properties, Assertion.properties). Search is **automatic and cascading**.

### Locator Management (NEVER hardcode)

**Use ObjectRepository for all locators**:
```java
By loginButton = ObjectRepository.getLocator("LOGIN_BUTTON"); // Reads from environment/{env}/Locator.properties

// Locator.properties format: LOCATOR_NAME=type:value
// LOGIN_BUTTON=xpath://button[@id='submit']
// LOGIN_USERNAME=id:username
```

**Supported locator types**: `id`, `name`, `xpath`, `css`, `class`, `linktext`, `partiallinktext`

**Why this matters**: Environment-specific locators (QA vs UAT may have different element IDs) without code changes.

### Page Object Pattern (Mandatory Structure)

```java
public class LoginPage {
    WebDriver driver;
    ElementUtil elementutil;
    By loginButton = ObjectRepository.getLocator("LOGIN_BUTTON"); // Load locator from properties
    
    public LoginPage(WebDriver driver) {
        this.driver = driver;
        elementutil = new ElementUtil(driver); // Wrap driver with retry logic
        PageFactory.initElements(driver, this); // Initialize @FindBy annotations if used
    }
    
    public void clickLogin() {
        elementutil.doClick(loginButton); // Use ElementUtil, NOT driver.findElement()
    }
}
```

**Register new pages** in `PageObjectManager`:
```java
private MyNewPage myNewPage; // Class-level field

public MyNewPage getMyNewPage() {
    return (myNewPage == null) ? myNewPage = new MyNewPage(driver) : myNewPage;
}
```

### Step Definition DI Pattern (Picocontainer)

**Constructor injection** (NO manual instantiation):
```java
public class StepDefinition {
    TestContext testContext;
    LoginPage loginPage;
    
    public StepDefinition(TestContext context) { // Picocontainer auto-injects
        this.testContext = context;
    }
    
    @Given("User launch the browser")
    public void user_launch_the_browser() {
        String browser = DriverManager.returnBrowserName(); // Reads -Dbrowser or defaults to "edge"
        testContext.initializeDriver(browser); // Initialize ThreadLocal driver
        loginPage = testContext.getPageObjectManager().getLoginPage(); // Get page object
    }
}
```

**Critical**: Always call `initializeDriver()` in first Given step. Driver is NOT initialized in @Before hook.

### Parallel Execution (TestNG DataProvider)

```xml
<!-- pom.xml -->
<configuration>
    <properties>
        <property>
            <name>dataproviderthreadcount</name>
            <value>1</value> <!-- Increase to 2-4 for parallel scenarios -->
        </property>
    </properties>
</configuration>
```

**TestRunner configuration**:
```java
@DataProvider(parallel = true) // Enables parallel scenario execution
public Object[][] scenarios() {
    return super.scenarios();
}
```

**Thread safety**: Each scenario gets isolated ThreadLocal driver instance. **Never share driver references** between scenarios.

## Build & Test Commands

```bash
# Default execution (QA environment, edge browser, headless)
mvn clean verify

# Specific environment and browser
mvn clean verify -Denv=UAT -Dbrowser=chrome

# Run tagged scenarios
mvn clean test -Denv=QA -Dbrowser=firefox -Dtest=TestRunner "-Dcucumber.filter.tags=@Smoke"

# Failed test rerun (automatic - FailedTestcaseRunner reads target/failedrerun.txt)
mvn clean verify -Dtest=FailedTestcaseRunner
```

### Maven Lifecycle Integration

- `verify` phase: Executes TestRunner via surefire-plugin
- `post-integration-test` phase: Generates ExtentReports from cucumber.json (extentreports-cucumberjson-plugin)
- `@BeforeSuite`: Clears `/test-output` and `/DownloadedReports` folders
- `@AfterSuite`: Optional Jira XRay test result import (REST API POST to `/import/execution/cucumber`)

## Configuration Flags (environment.properties)

```properties
# Jira XRay Integration
JiraUpdate=No                      # Set "Yes" to POST results to Jira (requires JiraUserID, JiraPassword, JiraAPIURL)

# Email Reporting
SEND_EMAIL_AFTER_EXECUTION=No      # Configure recipients in SendTestAutomationReport.java

# Screenshot Strategy
ATTACH_SCREENSHOT_TO_REPORT=No     # "Yes" captures screenshots after EVERY step (slower execution)
                                    # "No" captures only on failure (recommended for speed)
```

**Jira integration**: Posts `target/json-report/cucumber.json` to Jira XRay endpoint `/rest/raven/2.0/api/import/execution/cucumber` using basic auth.

## Adding New Tests (5-Step Process)

1. **Create feature file** (`src/test/resources/features/MyFeature.feature`):
```gherkin
@QA @UAT
Feature: My Feature
  Scenario: My test scenario
    Given User launch the browser
    When User performs action on "MY_BUTTON"
    Then User verifies "MY_SUCCESS_MESSAGE"
```

2. **Add locators** (`environment/{QA|UAT}/Locator.properties`):
```properties
MY_BUTTON=xpath://button[@id='myBtn']
MY_SUCCESS_MESSAGE=css:.success-msg
```

3. **Create Page Object** (`pages/MyFeature/MyPage.java`):
```java
public class MyPage {
    WebDriver driver;
    ElementUtil elementutil;
    By myButton = ObjectRepository.getLocator("MY_BUTTON");
    
    public MyPage(WebDriver driver) {
        this.driver = driver;
        elementutil = new ElementUtil(driver);
        PageFactory.initElements(driver, this);
    }
    
    public void clickMyButton() {
        elementutil.doClick(myButton); // Use ElementUtil wrapper
    }
}
```

4. **Register in PageObjectManager** (`objectManager/PageObjectManager.java`):
```java
private MyPage myPage; // Add field

public MyPage getMyPage() { // Add getter with lazy init
    return (myPage == null) ? myPage = new MyPage(driver) : myPage;
}
```

5. **Write step definitions** (`stepDef/MyStepDef.java`):
```java
public class MyStepDef {
    TestContext testContext;
    MyPage myPage;
    
    public MyStepDef(TestContext context) {
        this.testContext = context;
    }
    
    @When("User performs action on {string}")
    public void user_performs_action(String locatorKey) {
        myPage = testContext.getPageObjectManager().getMyPage();
        myPage.clickMyButton();
    }
}
```

## Common Pitfalls & Solutions

**Driver not initialized**
- ❌ Problem: NullPointerException when accessing driver
- ✅ Solution: Always call `testContext.initializeDriver(browser)` in first Given step

**Stale element exceptions**
- ❌ Problem: Direct WebDriver calls fail with StaleElementReferenceException
- ✅ Solution: Use `ElementUtil.doClick/doSendKeys` (built-in retry logic)

**Locator not found**
- ❌ Problem: `IllegalArgumentException: Locator for element 'X' not found`
- ✅ Solution: Add locator to `environment/{env}/Locator.properties` (case-sensitive key)

**Property not resolving**
- ❌ Problem: Property returns null
- ✅ Solution: Check `-Denv` matches folder name (case-sensitive: QA ≠ qa)

**Parallel test flakiness**
- ❌ Problem: Tests interfere with each other
- ✅ Solution: Verify ThreadLocal isolation - never store driver as static or share page objects across scenarios

**Headless mode issues**
- ℹ️ Info: All browsers configured with `--headless` by default in DriverManager.setDriver()
- ✅ Solution: Comment out headless options for debugging, re-enable for CI/CD

## Reporting & Debugging

**Generated Reports**:
- ExtentReports: `target/ExtentReports/` (generated in `post-integration-test` phase)
- Cucumber JSON: `target/json-report/cucumber.json` (used by ExtentReports and Jira integration)
- Cucumber HTML: `target/cucumber-reports.html`
- Failed scenarios: `target/failedrerun.txt` (consumed by FailedTestcaseRunner)

**Logging**: Log4j2 configured via `src/test/resources/log4j2.properties`. Use `LogManager.getLogger(ClassName.class)` in classes.

**Screenshot locations**:
- Embedded in ExtentReports (Base64 encoded)
- Attached to Cucumber JSON reports
- Captured in `@After` hook on test failure

## Test Data Strategies

1. **Scenario Outline** (inline examples in feature file):
```gherkin
Scenario Outline: Login test
  When User enters "<username>" and "<password>"
  Examples:
    | username | password |
    | user1    | pass1    |
```

2. **Excel-based** (environment-specific):
```java
// ExcelReader.ExcelReaderBuilder pattern
ExcelReader reader = new ExcelReader.ExcelReaderBuilder()
    .setFileLocation(Constants.TEST_DATA_FILE_PATH + env + "/TestData/LoginData.xlsx")
    .setSheet("Sheet1")
    .build();
List<List<String>> data = reader.getSheetData();
```

3. **Properties-based** (URLs, credentials):
```java
String url = PropertiesFileManager.getPropertyValue("MyURL"); // From environment.properties
String user = PropertiesFileManager.getPropertyValue("Username"); // From ApplicationUser.properties
```

**Excel data location**: `environment/{QA|UAT}/TestData/*.xlsx`

## Key File References

- Driver initialization: `driverFactory/DriverManager.java` (headless config, browser setup)
- Property resolution: `utils/PropertiesFileManager.java` (multi-file search logic)
- Locator parsing: `utils/ObjectRepository.java` (string-to-By conversion)
- Retry logic: `utils/ElementUtil.java` (StaleElement/Timeout handling)
- Test runner: `testRunner/TestRunner.java` (parallel config, Jira integration)
- Lifecycle hooks: `appHooks/ApplicationHook.java` (screenshot capture, teardown)
- DI container: `cucumber/TestContext.java` (driver lifecycle)
- Page factory: `objectManager/PageObjectManager.java` (lazy-init pattern)

## Framework Design Decisions

**Why ThreadLocal drivers?** Enables parallel test execution without race conditions. Each TestNG thread gets isolated driver instance.

**Why Picocontainer?** Automatic dependency injection for step definitions. No manual TestContext instantiation needed.

**Why lazy-initialized PageObjectManager?** Pages created only when needed, reducing memory footprint. Singleton per test context prevents duplicate page instances.

**Why separate environment folders?** QA and UAT can have different locators, URLs, test data without code changes. Switch environments via `-Denv` flag.

**Why ElementUtil wrapper?** Centralizes retry logic, explicit waits, and JS fallbacks. Reduces boilerplate in page objects.

**Why headless by default?** Faster execution in CI/CD pipelines. Remove headless flags in DriverManager for local debugging.
